facts.claim: 作者用‘丛林里没有阿司匹林’这则谐音笑话开篇，靠parrots eat ’em all读成paracetamol
facts.quote: Why are there no aspirins in the jungle? Because the parrots eat ’em all.

facts.claim: 作者收录一则精神科笑话，把two tents谐音成too tense，让诊断本身成为双关
facts.quote: ‘I know your problem,’ says the psychiatrist. ‘You’re two tents.’

facts.claim: 作者大量采用‘Doctor, doctor’对话体，让病人陈述症状、医生用一句话把语义掰到别处
facts.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, I think I have déjà vu.’ ‘Not you again!’

facts.claim: 作者用‘还能活多久’的死亡问题做倒数计时笑话，把‘10’拆成10、9、8的秒数
facts.quote: The doctor says, ‘Ten …’ ‘Ten what?’ asks the patient. ‘Years? Months?’ The doctor says, ‘Nine … eight …’

facts.claim: 作者收录牙医笑话，用Two-thirty谐音tooth hurty回答‘看牙最好的时间’
facts.quote: What’s the best time to visit the dentist? Two-thirty.

facts.claim: 作者把产房里的喊声当作Braxton-Hicks宫缩的谐音材料，用‘Toni can’t! Bill won’t!’消解紧张
facts.quote: There was nothing to worry about, they were just Braxton-Hicks contractions.

facts.claim: 作者以症状互换收尾，让手抖的抱怨落到‘我大部分都洒了’这种饮酒借口上
facts.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, my hands won’t stop shaking.’ ‘Do you drink a lot?’ ‘Not really, I spill most of it.’

relations.relation: 作者几乎不加解释地把谐音梗接连抛出，把读者当成一读就懂pun的同类
relations.quote: Why are there no aspirins in the jungle? Because the parrots eat ’em all.

relations.relation: 作者笔下的医生总能一句话把病人的主诉改写成另一个意思，冷静而不共情
relations.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, I think I’m a bridge.’ ‘What’s come over you?’

relations.relation: 作者让病人永远听不懂医生的双关，把误解固定在问答的错位上
relations.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, I keep seeing pink and green spots in front of my eyes.’ ‘Have you ever seen an optician?’ ‘No, just the pink and green spots.’

numbers.meaning: 看牙医的最佳时间，谐音tooth hurty
numbers.quote: What’s the best time to visit the dentist? Two-thirty.

numbers.meaning: 病人声称自己只剩六十秒可活
numbers.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, I have sixty seconds to live.’

numbers.meaning: 病人说手臂在三处骨折，医生叫他别去那些地方
numbers.quote: ‘Doctor, doctor, I’ve broken my arm in three places!’

numbers.value: Three lorries, fourteen cars and twenty-six pedestrians
numbers.meaning: 自称是桥的病人报出身上通过的车辆与行人数
numbers.quote: ‘Three lorries, fourteen cars and twenty-six pedestrians.’

numbers.meaning: 病人每天早晨七点准时排便，却八点才起床
numbers.quote: Every morning at 7 o’clock I have a great big, firm, regular bowel movement.
